title: AiModelLanguage - Data API
description: An object that stores language related information that is generated for each AI model. This object is available in API version 55.0 and later.

ApplicationType.description: Type of application using the AI model. Possible values are: ARTICLE_RECOMMENDATION EAR_FOR_CONVERSATION EAR_FOR_VOICE FAQ REPLY_RECOMMENDATION USE_CASE_EXPLORER UTTERANCE_RECOMMENDATION

ExternalAiModelId.description: ID of the AI model used to generate predictions. This field is a relationship field.

Language.description: Languages supported by this AI model. Possible values are: Arabic Chinese-simplified Chinese-traditional Dutch English French German Italian Japanese Korean Polish Portuguese Russian Spanish Thai Turkish

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort

ServingStatus.properties: Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ServingStatus.description: Determines if the language is enabled or disabled for this AI model.

TranscriptCount.description: Transcript count detected for each language.

special_access_rules:

                  permissions.
